messages.subject: Project Skylark - FTO search request (RapidCure)
messages.plaintextBody:
Alan,

We're licensing Halstead's RapidCure OOA cure process to an eVTOL OEM and need a freedom-to-operate search for the eVTOL field of use, focused on rapid OOA curing, heated-tooling control and vacuum-bag consolidation. The Halstead family is GB2578941B, EP3712198B1, US11,247,883B2 plus a pending PCT. Can you turn this around by 21 October?

James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Skylark - FTO search request (RapidCure)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Report ref HIP-FTO-2024-114 is done. Headline: residual FTO risk in the eVTOL field is LOW. Two third-party patents looked relevant on first pass - Mitsuwa Composites (EP3105112B1) and Toulon Aerospace (US10,894,367B2) - but neither reads onto RapidCure: the two-stage dwell profile and multi-zone tooling survey fall outside their claim scope. Full report to follow by post and DMS upload.

Dr Alan Foster
Hartington IP
